**1h**

### 2026-10-08 – Today I continued cleaning up the schematic from yesterday. At first I thought I would just spend my time manually rerouting wires around the board to make it look neater. Instead, I learned how to us

**2h**

Today I continued cleaning up the schematic from yesterday. At first I thought I would just spend my time manually rerouting wires around the board to make it look neater. Instead, I learned how to use net labels to clean up the design. This makes the schematic look significantly more organized and much easier to read than having messy wires crossing each other all over the place!
